purpose: Ask for or choose the greatest practical degree.
keywords: なるべく + desired action / state
Please reply as soon as you can.
I take a bag shopping whenever possible.
I will keep the explanation as short as possible.
formation: なるべく + desired action / state
restrictions: Leaves room for practical constraints; less absolute than 必ず.
mistake: なるべく早く means as early as possible, not necessarily immediately.
